ai.overview: The Columbus Blue Jackets bring the lineal championship belt to Buffalo on November 6th, 2026, having defended it once in their current reign. The Blue Jackets enter with momentum from two straight wins, while the Sabres look to bounce back from a narrow 1–2 loss to Ottawa and claim the belt for what would be their 88th time holding it.
key_matchups: Columbus riding a two-game winning streak including a 2–1 win over Dallas and a 7–2 blowout of Colorado
Buffalo's recent inconsistency after winning three straight before the Ottawa setback, including a high-scoring 7–6 win at Anaheim
